kit_page.name: scene_options_tab_content
kit_page.summary: Director hotkeys, their reference list, and what a scene file saves.
kit_page.text: F2 toggle console · F3 ACTION / CUT · F4 CUT · F5 reset to marks · F6 pose ghosts on/off · F7 take play/pause · F8 set marks · 1-9 punch camera-switcher slots (console visible, switcher armed, no text focus) · Alt+1-9 punch Anim Switchboard slots (console open, switchboard armed, no text focus) · Esc CUT while running (console focused). F-keys work while the Director or Actor Mover is open; F2 works always.

Cast, marks, groups and start delays, locomotion roles, subjects A-D, actor paths, per-actor gaze targets, performance and gaze cues, Actor FX styles; transport arming; camera switcher program; Flycam Orbit; Cinematic camera mode and preset; frame/lens guide; Actor Mover settings; Temporal capture modes; Virtual Cam captures/displays/gate; light rigs, Rig Rim, Roto Ink, Tron. Not saved yet: exposure/tonemap, lens looks, DoF, depth haze, projector shafts, weather, scene-light EVs, Pose Polish, Diopter.
